keySentence: She found a warm and safe home.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She helped a bird. The bird flew her away. They went to a warm land. She found a warm and safe home.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina spent the winter in the field mouse's warm home. In spring, she found a hurt swallow and nursed him. The swallow promised to take her somewhere beautiful. She found a warm and safe home in a sunny land. The swallow carried her on his back over mountains. They arrived in a land full of sunshine and flowers.
facts.Word cards: flew = 날았다 / warm = 따뜻한 / country = 나라 / swallow = 제비
